biggest_catch: Neither of you gets anything unless the friend is a homeowner AND takes at least two eligible services (energy, broadband, mobile, insurance) — a renter, or a friend who takes only energy, earns you both nothing.
catches: The friend must be a homeowner and switch at least two eligible services (Energy, Broadband, Mobile, Home Cover, Income Protector Insurance); Home Insurance and Bill Protector are excluded.
If the friend takes only one service, neither of you receives a Referral Bonus.
The Referral Bonus is paid on the second bill in the Credits & Debits section, only once all eligible services go live.
If the friend leaves during the cooling-off period or cancels a qualifying service, no bonus is paid.
For non-commercial use only — no paid promotions to share your personalised link.
UK homeowners only; confirm the program is still current before sharing.
